title: Workspace
description: The durable record of an isolated, reconstructible, credential-free materialisation of one or more repositories for exactly one GraphRun (ADR-0003 §7, ADR-0006). WorkspaceSpec is the creation input; this is the record. The record exists because a workspace outlives the process that created it: after a crash the platform must be able to tell whether a workspace is still leased, reclaimable or quarantined, and losing that knowledge means either leaking disk or destroying a workspace another process is using. Layout is fixed by ADR-0023 §1: one directory per repositoryId directly beneath the root.

schemaVersion.description: ADR-0024 §5: stored documents are versioned as data. One version exists in V1.

status.description: CREATING -> READY -> LEASED, then RELEASED -> DESTROYED on success, QUARANTINED -> DESTROYED on a failed run with bounded retention, or EXPIRED when the lease is lost and the workspace becomes reclaimable. QUARANTINED is a distinct state rather than delayed destruction because a workspace kept for diagnosis must not be handed to another run.

toolImageDigest.description: The digest-pinned image actually used (ADR-0006 §5). Recorded rather than re-derived, because reproducing a run means reproducing the toolchain it ran against.

repositories.description: What was materialised, with the commit each repository was resolved to. Together with the patch series this reconstructs the workspace (ADR-0003 §6), which is why losing a workspace is recoverable rather than fatal. Each repositoryId is the name of its directory beneath the workspace root (ADR-0023 §1).

lease.description: Exclusive. Two runs never share a checkout, and no run can reach another run's workspace or the developer's own repositories. Expiry makes the workspace collectable rather than silently shared.

executionMode.description: container is the default and the only mode with the isolation guarantees of ADR-0006 §4. unsafe-host-exec is an escape hatch that is disabled by default, requires a configuration change rather than a run flag, and is recorded here and on every audit entry so evaluation results produced under it can be excluded from comparison.

allOf.$comment: A leased workspace with no lease record is indistinguishable from an abandoned one, which is precisely the ambiguity the record exists to remove.
Destruction must be dated: retention of quarantined workspaces is bounded, and an undated terminal state cannot be swept.
